_note: Package for the FIRST v3 build (chain contract 3.0.0). The skill exists as a candidate at .claude/skills/llm-wiki-ingest; this build measures it against a bare baseline and the shape grader in the fixture. failure_kind is shape on purpose: the artefact is a page in a fixed schema, and check.py grades it without a judge.
_gap_observed: On 2026-09-02 the knowledge base's own lint found 9 errors and 51 warnings on 44 notes written without a shared ingest procedure: 6 dangling links, 2 notes with no sources block, 17 notes never registered in the index, 33 one-way links. Each is a step the ingest skipped. The gap is the missing procedure, and it shows in the files.
candidate_sentence: Turns one verified source into one wiki page in the shared schema - raw kept, triaged against the page that owns the topic, every number quoted before it is written, claims graded, neighbours naming the page back, index and log rows, lint clean - and emits the page, the register rows and the log line.
expected_failure: Given a fetched source and an existing wiki, the baseline writes a new page beside the one that already owns the topic, states numbers without the quoted line, overwrites a contradicted value with the newer one, and leaves the index, source log and back-links untouched. PREDICTION, NOT OBSERVATION: the probe decides; this repository's own history is that expected_failure was refuted 4 of 4 times.
trigger_terms: add this to the knowledge base
write a note from this page
threshold: Across k >= 2 repeats: zero regressions on correctness, no more than 20 percent worse on tokens or tool calls, and at least one win on correctness or shape that survives every repeat. A clean baseline does not stop the build; a win on shape alone satisfies the clause.

sources.title: LLM Wiki
sources.read_detail: Read by the second session on 2026-09-02 and compiled into knowledge/notes/llm-wiki-pattern.md; quotes below are from that note's verbatim lines.

claims.claim: An ingest touches many pages, not one: the gist says a single source may touch 10 to 15 wiki pages.
claims.quote: a single source may touch 10–15 wiki pages
claims.limits: the gist's own estimate for its author's wiki; no measurement published

claims.claim: Lint is a named operation with five targets: contradictions, stale claims, orphan pages, missing cross-references, data gaps.
claims.quote: health-check for contradictions, stale claims, orphan pages, missing cross-references, data gaps

claims.claim: Numbers, dates and quotes are located in the raw file before they are written into a page.
claims.locator: SKILL.md, Compile step of the ingest workflow
claims.quote: Every number, date, and direct quote must be located in the raw file before it is written

claims.claim: Lint is tiered: safe fixes applied, mechanical reports, judgement reports.
claims.quote: Safe Fixes (auto-fix): index consistency, internal link targets, Raw field references, See Also links

claims.claim: The implementation deliberately omits vector search and confidence scores because grep and read are more reliable at the wiki sizes it targets.
claims.quote: at 50K–100K tokens of curated wiki, grep and read are more reliable
claims.limits: the authors' judgement; no comparison published

claims.claim: A pre-commit hook blocks pages with an unresolved contradiction flag or a structural problem.
claims.quote: an unresolved contradiction flag or a structural problem (missing frontmatter, a broken [[link]], or a slug collision)
claims.limits: a mechanism; its effect on wiki quality is not measured

claims.claim: Tier-1 lint runs at every ingest over five structural checks.
claims.quote: Tier-1 lint at every ingest: required frontmatter fields, link resolution, source existence, quality block ranges, type/path consistency

representative_tasks.task: The wiki at pipeline/packages/fixtures/llm-wiki-ingest/wiki has a note that owns model prices. Ingest the source pipeline/packages/fixtures/llm-wiki-ingest/raw/2026-09-02-pricing-page.md into that wiki.
representative_tasks.artifact_expected: The owning note updated in place with a dated row per changed price and the new source in its frontmatter with a fetch date; the superseded price kept as history; no new page; a SOURCES row; a LOG line; the neighbour still naming the owner. Graded by fixture check.py T1.

representative_tasks.task: Ingest pipeline/packages/fixtures/llm-wiki-ingest/raw/2026-09-02-gamma-model-card.md into the same wiki. Its parameter count differs from what the wiki holds.
representative_tasks.artifact_expected: Both values kept as their own dated rows with their sources, the note marked disputed at that fact, neither value overwritten; SOURCES and LOG rows. Graded by check.py T2.
No page changed and no page created; one LOG line saying no material with the URL. Graded by check.py T3.

_claims_note: All seven claims are REPEATED: they are design rules and mechanisms, not measurements. The measurement this build produces is the first number; the fixture's check.py is the shape grader the contract names for failure_kind shape.
